criteria.statement: Full-project Compose rendering uses only the target deployment unit's services and records unit metadata.
Compose ownership is enforced before any desired-state command runs for the unit-owned compose directory.
CLI Compose executor validates staged Compose output and applies the full project under the RuntimeControlClient seam.
Desired-state Compose apply does not use service image environment substitution, service-scoped up, or force recreate.
Compose apply rejects a target deployment unit whose runtime type is not compose before staging or executor commands run.
